# Third-party Git host marks

The marks in this folder belong to their owners. They are shown on the
landing page of keepthewhy.com under "Git does the rest", in one row and
one color, to say which Git hosts the project knows: the same six the
dashboard's `HOSTS` table carries (`dashboard/ktw_dashboard/web/lib.js`).
Nothing here claims endorsement by or affiliation with any of them.

Origin: [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org/) 16.34.0, CC0, fetched
2026-10-07 — `github.svg`, `gitlab.svg`, `codeberg.svg`, `bitbucket.svg`,
`gitea.svg`, `forgejo.svg`, stored as received.

The page recolors them at render time with a CSS mask
(`docs/assets/extra.css`, `.ktw-hosts`); the files are not edited.

If you own one of these marks and want it removed or shown differently,
open an issue at https://github.com/oliver-zehentleitner/keep-the-why/issues
or write to the address on https://keepthewhy.com/imprint/.
